info.title: Eventy API
info.description: OpenAPI contract for the Eventy API.

get.description: Super admins can list organizers with the linked admin account plus event and session totals for each organizer.

post.description: Super admins can create an organizer together with its linked organizer admin account.

get.description: Super admins can fetch a single organizer with its linked admin account and organizer-scoped event summaries in one response.
Super admins can fetch the single organizer admin account attached to a specific organizer.

patch.description: Super admins can set a new password for the organizer admin account attached to an organizer.

get.description: Returns published events enriched for the public discovery experience, including organizer and category display data, the next upcoming session, and derived ticket summary fields.
Returns a published event with public-facing organizer, category, session, and ticket information.
Organizer admins only see events belonging to their organizer. Super admins can see every event.

post.description: Organizer admins create events for their own organizer. Super admins can create for any organizer by passing organizer_id.

get.description: Organizer admins can only fetch events belonging to their organizer. Super admins can fetch any event. The response includes sessions and ticket types for dashboard configuration.

post.description: Creates or updates a pending registration and sends a 6-digit OTP to the user's email.
Verifies the email OTP, creates the user, and returns an auth token.
Generates a new OTP for an existing pending registration and sends it to the same email.
Rotates the refresh token and returns a new access token plus refresh token.

patch.description: Authenticated users can change their password by providing their current password.

post.description: Generates a password reset OTP and sends it to the user's email.
Resets the user's password using the emailed OTP.

description.example: Curated screenings, premieres, and cultural film nights.

organizer_id.description: Required for super admins. Ignored unless it matches the token organizer for organizer admins.
